commit.message:
Post finished reviews as a single COMMENT, and never approve.

A webhook review is published as one pull-request review whose event is
COMMENT. The payload builder has no event argument, and APPROVE and
REQUEST_CHANGES are refused before any request. The body says the review
is advisory, then lists lenses, file coverage, limit stops and cost. A
retry of the same commit does not post twice, and a failed review posts
nothing. The posting token may ask for pull_requests write and still
refuses every other write.

Co-authored-by: Brandon Dees <brandondees@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
Ignore a planted review marker unless a bot wrote it on this commit.

A person who can comment on the pull request could otherwise copy the
idempotency marker and stop the service from posting. A marker on
another commit does not count either. A failed post still waits out its
backoff before the next try.

Co-authored-by: Brandon Dees <brandondees@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
Record the COMMENT write path and close the post race.

D46 amends D24. A post re-checks the head under the lock before create, stops at a 45-second deadline, waits on Retry-After, and does not retry an auth refusal. The posted body is tested against a planted secret and markup.

Co-authored-by: Brandon Dees <brandondees@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
Make COMMENT posting fail closed on auth, 422, and the attempt clock.

A 403 is a rate limit only when the budget is exhausted, Retry-After is set, or the body names a secondary limit. The scrubber covers the Sprites token, the model key, and minted tokens. The marker matches this App's bot. D46 records the choice, the cost, and what it does not change.

Co-authored-by: Brandon Dees <brandondees@users.noreply.github.com>

test_the_module_entry_shares_the_poster_hook fails when the guard calls this file's own main. test_a_stop_during_the_post_keeps_the_draft fails when that stop is settled as superseded.
